work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission of a source-pinned same-model two-harness pair intentionally retained by the publisher under do-not-include. W1 preserves the two committed run summaries as neutral benchmark observations and preserves the publisher's exclusion/caveat state without importing its paired statistical or cost-ranking interpretation.

source_known_dimensions: same Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 model artifact label served as qwen3.6-35b-fp8
same qwen3_coder tool-call parser and thinking-enabled serving policy
same g6e.4xlarge single-L40S hardware and TP=1 configuration
same native 262144 context window and fp8 KV-cache serving configuration
same mcp-gateway-registry-v2 21-task surface and swe3 skill
same six-artifact workflow; both runs produced 126 of 126 expected artifacts
same repo-grounded openai.gpt-5.6-sol judge at high reasoning effort
both runs scored all 21 tasks with zero task failures
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: immutable Hugging Face checkpoint revision for Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8
Codex and OMP are different harness implementations with different versioned CLIs by design
runs occurred on adjacent dates rather than one simultaneous field window
endpoint/service state outside committed artifacts may have changed between 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-11
task ordering and serial-run history may differ
Codex and OMP expose different cache-accounting conventions, so raw input-token fields are not directly comparable

publisher_exclusion_reasons: the throughput and hardware-derived cost sweep uses g6e.4xlarge rather than the publisher's canonical fleet hardware basis
cross-precision comparisons against the BF16 Qwen3.6 result are context-window-confounded because this FP8 configuration uses 262144 while the BF16 configuration uses 200000
source_status.w1_treatment: preserved as source metadata; not converted into a paper eligibility verdict

non_admission_dispositions.surface: publisher paired Codex-versus-OMP delta, confidence interval, and cost ranking
non_admission_dispositions.reason: Those are source analysis/statistical interpretation. W1 preserves each committed harness result and factual telemetry but does not adopt the ordering, paired inference, or cost conclusion.
The source explicitly identifies the FP8 and BF16 configurations as distinct artifacts with different precision, hardware, served names, and context-window settings. W1 keeps them separate.
